task.objective: Acquire a single-shot reduced-FOV gradient-echo EPI image using a genuine 2D spatially selective RF excitation. Select a central 160 mm extent in x and 100 mm extent in y within the prescribed 200 x 200 mm FOV. The cardiac anatomy fits within the x extent; the reduced phase FOV is the central half in y. Preserve 6.25 mm spatial resolution: acquire 32 x 16 samples, retaining even zero-based ky indices of the prescribed 32 x 32 full-FOV grid, with 32 samples per x readout and alternating readout polarity. Use one excitation/readout shot; do not use a refocusing pulse or reconstruct an undersampled full-FOV image as a substitute for spatial selection. RF must overlap encoding gradients in both x and y. Suppress signal outside the selected rectangle, including x outside 80 mm and y outside 50 mm, and produce coherent signal within it. Diagnostic water spins must retain at least 0.20 of equilibrium PD at every tested interior point. The largest exterior magnitude divided by mean interior magnitude must be no more than 0.10. Interior probes cover x=-56,0,56 mm and nine y positions spanning -35 to 35 mm. Stopband probes cover y=-96 to -65 mm and 65 to 96 mm at those x positions, plus x=-96,-92,92,96 mm at y=-25,0,25 mm. The judge verifies the excitation response in both dimensions, reduced-FOV sampling, EPI polarity, and the reconstructed cardiac image under declared B0 and intrinsic fat chemical shift. Use the fixed cropped BART FFT reconstruction. TE at the central-ky echo is an upper limit; choose pulse duration and timing within the supplied hardware and SAR limits. Image encoding is measured from the end of the final RF-containing block, including its selection-gradient rewinding. The phase oracle retains the RF selection gradients and declared fields, and excludes subsequent imaging gradients and your submitted ADC phase.

object.description: Static cardiac short-axis slice at 3 T with field-specific tissue relaxation and fat chemical shift.

physics.description: Static scanner-frame B0 variation at a 3 T reference field; Hz offsets scale linearly with the selected scanner B0. Intrinsic fat chemical shift is supplied separately by the cardiac phantom.

provenance.notes: Published values: field_strength_T, max_gradient_mT_per_m and max_slew_T_per_m_per_s. Gradient limits are per axis, not vector sums. max_b1_uT, dead times and rasters are shared benchmark assumptions shared synthetic benchmark assumptions, not manufacturer specifications. This is a limit profile, not a complete scanner model.
